question: What sense, if any, have you made of your experiences in the evenings?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “I haven’t settled on an explanation. Sometimes I think it might be a neighbor through the wall, but I remember hearing it once when that apartment was vacant, so that doesn’t quite fit. I’m still unsure. I do notice it’s more distracting after work than when I’m working.”
